<thought>We need to determine the number of unique hydrogen environments in the compound. The tool `proton_nmr_spectra` returns the 1H NMR spectrum for the target SMILES, and the task likely has a hidden SMILES associated with this subtask. We'll call the tool without arguments to obtain the spectrum, then count the distinct signals (peaks) which correspond to unique proton environments.</thought>
<action>proton_nmr_spectra</action>
<action_input>{}</action_input>
